captions.detailed: This 3D model features a twin-column candy vending machine. It consists of a red main cabinet with a tan front panel, two clear cylindrical canisters mounted on top with red lids, and a tall red backboard. Two white selector knobs are positioned on the front panel, and a small red flap sits at the bottom center covering the collection chute. Each selector knob rotates continuously on its own horizontal shaft, while the collection flap pivots on a small lower hinge to open the chute.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a twin-column candy vending machine with a red cabinet, a tan front faceplate, and a tall backboard. Include two transparent glass canisters on top filled with light pink and light blue contents, sealed with red lids. Add two white selector knobs that can rotate continuously, and a small red flap for the central collection chute that pivots on a bottom hinge.
captions.factory: The code constructs the vending machine starting with a base cabinet, backboard, and front panel using Box primitives. The canisters are formed from transparent glass Cylinders, filled with colored cylindrical solids representing candy, and capped with red cylindrical lids. Two selector knobs are modeled with cylindrical shafts and extruded profiles, attached to the cabinet via continuous joint articulations. A rectangular flap is created for the collection chute and articulated with a revolute joint near its lower edge.
